description: Learner experience, 40-band. Turn constructed notebooks into GATED tutorials: later sections/topics unlock only when the learner passes embedded knowledge checks that exercise their understanding. This generalizes nbstatus.py + tests/test_notebooks.py from an author-side 'is it built?' gate into a learner-side progression gate, and extends the construction agent (30) to also emit the knowledge checks. Depends on 30 (there must be constructed tutorials to gate). Anti-fabrication: gating must be real — a learner cannot advance without actually passing the check; auto-graded checks must truly assert, and LLM-graded checks must be recorded with the learner's answer. A story passes only when progression is genuinely blocked/unblocked by check results and the gate is green.
warmup: echo '--- how status is computed today ---'; head -60 nbstatus.py

userStories.title: AI-generated knowledge checks per section
acceptanceCriteria: The construction flow (from 30) also generates knowledge-check items for each section/topic that exercise the concept — a mix suited to the content: code-assertion exercises (auto-graded), multiple-choice (auto-graded), and short-answer (graded by the LLM client with the learner's answer recorded).
Checks are stored alongside the notebook in a defined, testable format and regenerate idempotently.
A test verifies that a constructed topic yields well-formed, gradable checks.

userStories.title: Gated progression in the app
acceptanceCriteria: In the app, sections/topics after the first are LOCKED until the learner passes the prior section's checks; passing unlocks the next; the learner cannot skip a gate.
Per-learner progress (which checks passed, which sections unlocked) is tracked and persists across restarts.
The UI shows locked/unlocked state and check results clearly.
Gate green: cargo build + npm run build pass and a progression smoke test confirms a failed check keeps the next section locked while a passed check unlocks it (document it in the progress log).
